notes.title: The flying airport level is coming
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/KMwUEFp.png

A new Level is on the go for LAST SOUL. Now that we almost finished all the basic backgrounds of our game on PixelArt, we started implementing the next phase of our coding. We plan to have ready at least four new levels during this month and we're going at great speed.

The Tutorial level on the Prologue Version of LAST SOUL finishing with the escape of our hero "BOP" to the earth. This is when the Airport Level will come around. You'll get to this place where more challenging CB-Troopers will wait to confront you.

Follow our progress

A great part of the development of our game is done while we stream on our Twitch channel. Don't miss your chance to make questions and suggestions related to the game, but also to learn a bit about the tools we use for their creation. The head of Our Dev Team and founder of Wulum (Tony Munoz) will answer all your questions with pleasure. 

[previewyoutube=ciUank8VCBk;full][/previewyoutube]

And don't forget!!!

Remember that if you want to try Alphas and Betas of our game, you only have to join our Mailing List. Play LAST SOUL before anyone else. Be part of this wonderful shooting, action, retro, PixeArt party.
